sentences.zh: 同治元年壬戌

translations.literal: Tongzhi reign, year 1, renxu
translations.idiomatic: First year of the Tongzhi reign (renxu)

sentences.zh: 二月庚申革。吏部尚書。

translations.literal: Second month, day gengshen, stripped of office; Minister of the Board of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day of the second month he was stripped of office as Minister of the Board of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 二月庚申遷。辛酉戶部尚書。

translations.literal: Second month, day gengshen, transferred; day xinyou, Minister of the Board of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day of the second month he was transferred; on the xinyou day he became Minister of the Board of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 七月庚子卒。戶部尚書。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day gengzi, died; Minister of the Board of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day of the seventh month he died while serving as Minister of the Board of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 正月己亥卒。兵部尚書。

translations.literal: First month, day jihai, died; Minister of the Board of War.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day of the first month he died while serving as Minister of the Board of War.

sentences.zh: 正月己亥遷。工部尚書。閏八月丙申遷。工部尚書。

translations.literal: First month, day jihai, transferred; Minister of the Board of Works. Intercalary eighth month, day bingshen, transferred; Minister of the Board of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day of the first month he was transferred to Minister of the Board of Works; on the bingshen day of the intercalary eighth month he was again transferred to Minister of the Board of Works.

sentences.zh: 三月庚子卒。工部尚書。

translations.literal: Third month, day gengzi, died; Minister of the Board of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day of the third month he died while serving as Minister of the Board of Works.

sentences.zh: 閏八月丙申遷。吏部左侍郎。

translations.literal: Intercalary eighth month, day bingshen, transferred; Left Vice-Minister of the Board of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day of the intercalary eighth month he was transferred to Left Vice-Minister of the Board of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 三月庚子遷。吏部左侍郎。六月庚午吏部左侍郎。

translations.literal: Third month, day gengzi, transferred; Left Vice-Minister of the Board of Personnel. Sixth month, day gengwu, Left Vice-Minister of the Board of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day of the third month he was transferred to Left Vice-Minister of the Board of Personnel; on the gengwu day of the sixth month, Left Vice-Minister of the Board of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 閏八月丙申遷。吏部右侍郎。

translations.literal: Intercalary eighth month, day bingshen, transferred; Right Vice-Minister of the Board of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day of the intercalary eighth month he was transferred to Right Vice-Minister of the Board of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 正月己亥遷。戶部左侍郎。二月辛酉遷。戶部左侍郎。

translations.literal: First month, day jihai, transferred; Left Vice-Minister of the Board of Revenue. Second month, day xinyou, transferred; Left Vice-Minister of the Board of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day of the first month he was transferred to Left Vice-Minister of the Board of Revenue; on the xinyou day of the second month he was again transferred to Left Vice-Minister of the Board of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 閏八月甲午戶部左侍郎。

translations.literal: Intercalary eighth month, day jiawu, Left Vice-Minister of the Board of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day of the intercalary eighth month, Left Vice-Minister of the Board of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 正月己亥遷。戶部右侍郎。七月庚子遷。戶部右侍郎。

translations.literal: First month, day jihai, transferred; Right Vice-Minister of the Board of Revenue. Seventh month, day gengzi, transferred; Right Vice-Minister of the Board of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day of the first month he was transferred to Right Vice-Minister of the Board of Revenue; on the gengzi day of the seventh month he was again transferred to Right Vice-Minister of the Board of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 三月丙午遷。禮部左侍郎。

translations.literal: Third month, day bingwu, transferred; Left Vice-Minister of the Board of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day of the third month he was transferred to Left Vice-Minister of the Board of Rites.

sentences.zh: 閏八月甲午遷。禮部左侍郎。

translations.literal: Intercalary eighth month, day jiawu, transferred; Left Vice-Minister of the Board of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day of the intercalary eighth month he was transferred to Left Vice-Minister of the Board of Rites.

sentences.zh: 三月庚子遷。禮部右侍郎。六月庚午遷。禮部右侍郎。七月庚子遷。禮部右侍郎。閏八月甲午遷。禮部右侍郎。

translations.literal: Third month, day gengzi, transferred; Right Vice-Minister of the Board of Rites. Sixth month, day gengwu, transferred; Right Vice-Minister of the Board of Rites. Seventh month, day gengzi, transferred; Right Vice-Minister of the Board of Rites. Intercalary eighth month, day jiawu, transferred; Right Vice-Minister of the Board of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day of the third month he was transferred to Right Vice-Minister of the Board of Rites; on the gengwu day of the sixth month he was again transferred to Right Vice-Minister of the Board of Rites; on the gengzi day of the seventh month he was again transferred to Right Vice-Minister of the Board of Rites; on the jiawu day of the intercalary eighth month he was again transferred to Right Vice-Minister of the Board of Rites.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙丑革。丙寅兵部左侍郎。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day yichou, stripped of office. Day bingyin, Left Vice-Minister of the Board of War.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day of the eleventh month he was stripped of office; on the bingyin day he became Left Vice-Minister of the Board of War.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲寅乞養。兵部左侍郎。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jiayin, requested leave to care for parents; Left Vice-Minister of the Board of War.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day of the eleventh month he requested leave to care for his parents while serving as Left Vice-Minister of the Board of War.

sentences.zh: 正月乙未遷。兵部右侍郎。二月辛酉遷。兵部右侍郎。三月丙午遷。補。

translations.literal: First month, day yiwei, transferred; Right Vice-Minister of the Board of War. Second month, day xinyou, transferred; Right Vice-Minister of the Board of War. Third month, day bingwu, transferred; appointed to fill vacancy.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day of the first month he was transferred to Right Vice-Minister of the Board of War; on the xinyou day of the second month he was again transferred to Right Vice-Minister of the Board of War; on the bingwu day of the third month he was transferred to fill the vacancy.

sentences.zh: 正月丙午遷。丁未兵部右侍郎。

translations.literal: First month, day bingwu, transferred; day dingwei, Right Vice-Minister of the Board of War.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day of the first month he was transferred; on the dingwei day he became Right Vice-Minister of the Board of War.

sentences.zh: 閏八月丙申遷。刑部右侍郎。十一月乙卯遷。刑部右侍郎。

translations.literal: Intercalary eighth month, day bingshen, transferred; Right Vice-Minister of the Board of Punishments. Eleventh month, day yimao, transferred; Right Vice-Minister of the Board of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day of the intercalary eighth month he was transferred to Right Vice-Minister of the Board of Punishments; on the yimao day of the eleventh month he was again transferred to Right Vice-Minister of the Board of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 七月庚子遷。工部左侍郎。十一月乙卯遷。工部左侍郎。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day gengzi, transferred; Left Vice-Minister of the Board of Works. Eleventh month, day yimao, transferred; Left Vice-Minister of the Board of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day of the seventh month he was transferred to Left Vice-Minister of the Board of Works; on the yimao day of the eleventh month he was again transferred to Left Vice-Minister of the Board of Works.

sentences.zh: 七月丙申遷。工部右侍郎。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day bingshen, transferred; Right Vice-Minister of the Board of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day of the seventh month he was transferred to Right Vice-Minister of the Board of Works.

sentences.zh: 同治二年癸亥

translations.literal: Tongzhi reign, year 2, guihai
translations.idiomatic: Second year of the Tongzhi reign (guihai)

sentences.zh: 十二月戊子卒。兵部尚書。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day wuzi, died; Minister of the Board of War.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day of the twelfth month he died while serving as Minister of the Board of War.

sentences.zh: 卒。二月工部尚書。

translations.literal: Died. Second month, Minister of the Board of Works.
translations.idiomatic: He died; in the second month he had been Minister of the Board of Works.

sentences.zh: 正月戊申遷。己酉吏部左侍郎。二月遷。吏部左侍郎。

translations.literal: First month, day wushen, transferred; day jiyou, Left Vice-Minister of the Board of Personnel. Second month, transferred; Left Vice-Minister of the Board of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day of the first month he was transferred; on the jiyou day he became Left Vice-Minister of the Board of Personnel; in the second month he was again transferred to Left Vice-Minister of the Board of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 二月遷。吏部右侍郎。未任。署。五月辛未吏部右侍郎。

translations.literal: Second month, transferred; Right Vice-Minister of the Board of Personnel. Did not take office. Acting appointment. Fifth month, day xinwei, Right Vice-Minister of the Board of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month he was transferred to Right Vice-Minister of the Board of Personnel but did not take office and served in an acting capacity; on the xinwei day of the fifth month he became Right Vice-Minister of the Board of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 十月辛丑遷。壬寅署戶部左侍郎。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day xinchou, transferred; day renyin, acting Left Vice-Minister of the Board of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day of the tenth month he was transferred; on the renyin day he was appointed acting Left Vice-Minister of the Board of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 五月辛未遷。禮部左侍郎。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day xinwei, transferred; Left Vice-Minister of the Board of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day of the fifth month he was transferred to Left Vice-Minister of the Board of Rites.

sentences.zh: 正月庚午遷。辛未禮部右侍郎。

translations.literal: First month, day gengwu, transferred; day xinwei, Right Vice-Minister of the Board of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day of the first month he was transferred; on the xinwei day he became Right Vice-Minister of the Board of Rites.

sentences.zh: 五月辛未遷。禮部右侍郎。十二月差。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day xinwei, transferred; Right Vice-Minister of the Board of Rites. Twelfth month, dispatched on assignment.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day of the fifth month he was transferred to Right Vice-Minister of the Board of Rites; in the twelfth month he was dispatched on special assignment.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊子署兵部左侍郎。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day wuzi, acting Left Vice-Minister of the Board of War.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day of the twelfth month he was appointed acting Left Vice-Minister of the Board of War.

sentences.zh: 二月乙酉遷。兵部左侍郎。

translations.literal: Second month, day yiyou, transferred; Left Vice-Minister of the Board of War.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day of the second month he was transferred to Left Vice-Minister of the Board of War.

sentences.zh: 二月甲午革。刑部右侍郎。

translations.literal: Second month, day jiawu, stripped of office; Right Vice-Minister of the Board of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day of the second month he was stripped of office while serving as Right Vice-Minister of the Board of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 四月賜卹。刑部右侍郎。

translations.literal: Fourth month, posthumous honors conferred; Right Vice-Minister of the Board of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month posthumous honors were conferred while he held the post of Right Vice-Minister of the Board of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 正月己酉遷。工部左侍郎。二月乙酉遷。工部左侍郎。

translations.literal: First month, day jiyou, transferred; Left Vice-Minister of the Board of Works. Second month, day yiyou, transferred; Left Vice-Minister of the Board of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day of the first month he was transferred to Left Vice-Minister of the Board of Works; on the yiyou day of the second month he was again transferred to Left Vice-Minister of the Board of Works.

sentences.zh: 遷。十月庚辰工部右侍郎。十二月戊子遷。工部右侍郎。

translations.literal: Transferred. Tenth month, day gengchen, Right Vice-Minister of the Board of Works. Twelfth month, day wuzi, transferred; Right Vice-Minister of the Board of Works.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred; on the gengchen day of the tenth month he became Right Vice-Minister of the Board of Works; on the wuzi day of the twelfth month he was again transferred to Right Vice-Minister of the Board of Works.

sentences.zh: 二月乙酉遷。工部右侍郎。五月辛未遷。工部右侍郎。

translations.literal: Second month, day yiyou, transferred; Right Vice-Minister of the Board of Works. Fifth month, day xinwei, transferred; Right Vice-Minister of the Board of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day of the second month he was transferred to Right Vice-Minister of the Board of Works; on the xinwei day of the fifth month he was again transferred to Right Vice-Minister of the Board of Works.

sentences.zh: 同治三年甲子

translations.literal: Tongzhi reign, year 3, jiazi
translations.idiomatic: Third year of the Tongzhi reign (jiazi)

sentences.zh: 七月癸亥假。禮部尚書。六月署。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day guihai, leave of absence; Minister of the Board of Rites. Sixth month, acting appointment.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day of the seventh month he took leave while serving as Minister of the Board of Rites; in the sixth month he had served in an acting capacity.

sentences.zh: 遷。七月癸亥工部尚書。

translations.literal: Transferred. Seventh month, day guihai, Minister of the Board of Works.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred; on the guihai day of the seventh month he became Minister of the Board of Works.

sentences.zh: 正月乙丑休。丙寅吏部左侍郎。未任。兼署。

translations.literal: First month, day yichou, retired. Day bingyin, Left Vice-Minister of the Board of Personnel. Did not take office. Concurrently acting.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day of the first month he retired; on the bingyin day he was appointed Left Vice-Minister of the Board of Personnel but did not take office and served concurrently in an acting capacity.

sentences.zh: 正月丙寅遷。吏部右侍郎。

translations.literal: First month, day bingyin, transferred; Right Vice-Minister of the Board of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day of the first month he was transferred to Right Vice-Minister of the Board of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 七月庚戌遷。戶部左侍郎。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day gengxu, transferred; Left Vice-Minister of the Board of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day of the seventh month he was transferred to Left Vice-Minister of the Board of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 正月丙寅遷。禮部右侍郎。七月癸亥遷。禮部右侍郎。署。

translations.literal: First month, day bingyin, transferred; Right Vice-Minister of the Board of Rites. Seventh month, day guihai, transferred; Right Vice-Minister of the Board of Rites. Acting appointment.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day of the first month he was transferred to Right Vice-Minister of the Board of Rites; on the guihai day of the seventh month he was again transferred to Right Vice-Minister of the Board of Rites in an acting capacity.

sentences.zh: 七月癸亥遷。刑部左侍郎。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day guihai, transferred; Left Vice-Minister of the Board of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day of the seventh month he was transferred to Left Vice-Minister of the Board of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 七月庚戌遷。刑部右侍郎。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day gengxu, transferred; Right Vice-Minister of the Board of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day of the seventh month he was transferred to Right Vice-Minister of the Board of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 八月癸酉病免。工部右侍郎。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day guiyou, relieved due to illness; Right Vice-Minister of the Board of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day of the eighth month he was relieved due to illness while serving as Right Vice-Minister of the Board of Works.

sentences.zh: 四月丁亥工部右侍郎。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day dinghai, Right Vice-Minister of the Board of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day of the fourth month, Right Vice-Minister of the Board of Works.

sentences.zh: 同治四年乙丑

translations.literal: Tongzhi reign, year 4, yichou
translations.idiomatic: Fourth year of the Tongzhi reign (yichou)

sentences.zh: 十一月壬申卒。禮部尚書。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day renshen, died; Minister of the Board of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day of the eleventh month he died while serving as Minister of the Board of Rites.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬申遷。兵部尚書。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day renshen, transferred; Minister of the Board of War.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day of the eleventh month he was transferred to Minister of the Board of War.

sentences.zh: 二月丁亥卒。戊子刑部尚書。

translations.literal: Second month, day dinghai, died; day wuzi, Minister of the Board of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day of the second month he died; on the wuzi day he had been Minister of the Board of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙丑遷。戶部左侍郎。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day yichou, transferred; Left Vice-Minister of the Board of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day of the eleventh month he was transferred to Left Vice-Minister of the Board of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬申遷。戶部右侍郎。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day renshen, transferred; Right Vice-Minister of the Board of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day of the eleventh month he was transferred to Right Vice-Minister of the Board of Revenue.
